originalTitle: American Airlines (AAL) Registers a Bigger Fall Than the Market: Important Facts to Note
summary: In the closing of the recent trading day, American Airlines (AAL) stood at $13.38, denoting a -1.73% move from the preceding trading day.
content:
American Airlines (AAL) closed the most recent trading day at $13.38, moving -1.73% from the previous trading session. This change lagged the S&P 500's daily loss of 0.25%. Elsewhere, the Dow saw a downswing of 0.86%, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq appreciated by 0.24%.

Coming into today, shares of the world's largest airline had gained 5.1% in the past month. In that same time, the Transportation sector lost 6.09%, while the S&P 500 lost 0.42%.

The upcoming earnings release of American Airlines will be of great interest to investors. On that day, American Airlines is projected to report earnings of -$0.31 per share, which would represent a year-over-year decline of 82.35%. Meanwhile, our latest consensus estimate is calling for revenue of $16.12 billion, up 17.74% from the prior-year quarter.

Looking at the full year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates suggest analysts are expecting earnings of -$0.25 per share and revenue of $63.03 billion. These totals would mark changes of -169.44% and +15.36%, respectively, from last year.

Additionally, investors should keep an eye on any recent revisions to analyst forecasts for American Airlines. These revisions typically reflect the latest short-term business trends, which can change frequently. Therefore, positive revisions in estimates convey analysts' confidence in the business performance and profit potential.

Our research suggests that these changes in estimates have a direct relationship with upcoming stock price performance. To take advantage of this, we've established the Zacks Rank, an exclusive model that considers these estimated changes and delivers an operational rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, which varies between #1 (Strong Buy) and #5 (Strong Sell), carries an impressive track record of exceeding expectations, confirmed by external audits, with stocks at #1 delivering an average annual return of +25% since 1988. Over the past month, the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has moved 60.4% lower. American Airlines currently has a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold).

The Transportation - Airline industry is part of the Transportation sector. This industry currently has a Zacks Industry Rank of 233, which puts it in the bottom 6% of all 250+ industries.

The Zacks Industry Rank is ordered from best to worst in terms of the average Zacks Rank of the individual companies within each of these sectors. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

You can find more information on all of these metrics, and much more, on Zacks.com.

chineseTitle: 美国航空 (AAL) 的跌幅大于市场：需要注意的重要事实
chineseSummary: 最近一个交易日收盘，美国航空 (AAL) 股价报 13.38 美元，较前一交易日上涨 -1.73%。
chineseContent:
美国航空 (AAL) 最近一个交易日收于 13.38 美元，较前一交易日上涨 -1.73%。这一变化落后于标准普尔 500 指数 0.25% 的日跌幅。其他方面，道指下跌 0.86%，而以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数则上涨 0.24%。

截至今天，这家全球最大航空公司的股价在过去一个月内上涨了 5.1%。与此同时，交通运输板块下跌 6.09%，标准普尔 500 指数下跌 0.42%。

美国航空即将发布的财报将引起投资者的极大兴趣。当日，美国航空预计每股收益为-0.31美元，同比下降82.35%。与此同时，我们最新的共识预测收入为 161.2 亿美元，比去年同期增长 17.74%。

纵观全年，Zacks 一致估计表明分析师预计每股收益为 - 0.25 美元，收入为 630.3 亿美元。与去年相比，这些总数将分别发生-169.44% 和+15.36% 的变化。

此外，投资者应关注美国航空分析师预测的最新修订。这些修订通常反映最新的短期业务趋势，这些趋势可能经常变化。因此，预测的积极修正传达了分析师对业务业绩和利润潜力的信心。

我们的研究表明，这些预估变化与即将到来的股价表现有直接关系。为了利用这一点，我们建立了 Zacks Rank，这是一个独特的模型，考虑了这些估计的变化并提供了一个可操作的评级系统。

Zacks Rank 系统介于#1（强力买入）和#5（强力卖出）之间，具有超出预期的令人印象深刻的记录，经外部审计证实，自 1988 年以来，排名第一的股票的平均年回报率为 +25%。在过去的一个月里，Zacks 共识 EPS 估计下降了 60.4%。美国航空目前的 Zacks 排名为#3（持有）。

运输 - 航空业是运输部门的一部分。该行业目前的 Zacks 行业排名为 233，在所有 250 多个行业中排名垫底 6%。

Zacks 行业排名是根据每个行业内各个公司的平均 Zacks 排名从最好到最差排序的。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
